text: At the fixed accepted revision, MarkThreadRead checks GetDBForHeader, but it does not check the result of IsRead or MarkRead. It appends the key after the write call and ends with NS_OK. The base database IsRead missing-header branch returns NS_MSG_MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND without setting its output. If that query fails, the caller can use an unset read value; if a write fails, it can record that key as updated. These are conditional static concerns, not reproduced failures. Recommend focused tests that force each per-message query/write failure and check the returned status, updated-key list and state/count changes before adopting a fix. Source inspection only; no failure injection, Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran. Complete historical discussion remains pending.
title: Check per-message read failures before recording a thread as updated
